info.name: Apache Oozie REST Admin Jobs API

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter criteria as URL-encoded semicolon-delimited key=value pairs (e.g., user=admin;status=RUNNING).

params.name: len
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

params.name: timezone
params.description: Timezone for date formatting in response.

params.name: jobtype
params.description: Filter by job type (wf, coordinator, bundle).

params.name: bulk
params.description: Bulk filter for coordinator action status queries.

items.docs: Returns a list of jobs matching the specified filters with pagination support.

params.name: action
params.description: Set to "start" to immediately start the submitted job.

params.name: jobtype
params.description: Job type for proxy submissions without a workflow XML.

items.docs: Submit a workflow, coordinator, or bundle job using an XML configuration payload. Use the action=start query parameter to submit and immediately start the job. Use jobtype for proxy submissions (mapreduce, pig, hive, sqoop) without a workflow XML.

params.name: action
params.description: Action to apply to matching jobs.

params.name: filter
params.description: Filter criteria for selecting target jobs.

params.name: len
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to affect.

items.docs: Apply an action (kill, suspend, resume) to multiple jobs matching filter criteria.

params.name: file
params.description: Local or HDFS path to the XML file to validate.

items.docs: Validates a workflow, coordinator, or bundle XML definition from the local filesystem or HDFS. The file path is provided as a query parameter and the XML content in the request body.
